title: Separate epistemic reasoning from mechanical execution
claim: Rezon can delegate bounded mechanical work to Project Runner without transferring epistemic admission, visibility, provenance, or semantic authority to Runner.
preserved_boundaries: Rezon remains owner of epistemic semantics.
Runner receives only bounded executable work and mechanical success criteria.
Runner completion cannot imply Rezon admission or truth.
rejection_conditions: Runner must understand Rezon-specific truth/admission semantics to execute work.
Rezon becomes dependent on Runner for local reasoning that should remain standalone.
Mechanical success can be mistaken for epistemic success.
Failure of Runner prevents Rezon from retaining a viable fallback execution path.

critical_objections: The proposed boundary may merely move complexity into adapters.
A common execution substrate may become de facto authority through operational dependence.

notes: First experiment should be nondestructive and reversible.
